transcript.text: Start by reading the files. for f in ['chart.py','summary.txt','table.csv']: print('=== ',f); print(open(f).read()) continue

Three flaws, each traced to chart.py against table.csv and summary.txt: 1. Master's Degree is plotted as 36, but table.csv says 20. Fix: set it to 20. 2. summary.txt describes a funnel chart, but chart.py draws a go.Bar. Fix: switch to go.Funnel, with the stages on the y axis and the values on x, in the stated top-to-bottom order. 3. summary.txt says the vertical axis is labeled "Education Level", but the y axis is titled "Labor Force Percentage (%)". Fix: title the y axis "Education Level" and the x (value) axis "Labor Force Percentage (%)". Everything else stays as it is: colors, title, layout, and grid styling. After running, I'll read the trace type, values and axis titles back from the figure, and look at the render. src = open('chart.py').read() src = src.replace("[100, 85, 70, 60, 45, 36, 8]", "[100, 85, 70, 60, 45, 20, 8]") src = src.replace("""fig = go.Figure(go.Bar( x=stages, y=educated_labor_force,""", """fig = go.Figure(go.Funnel( y=stages, x=educated_labor_force,""") src = src.replace('fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Labor Force Percentage (%)")', 'fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Education Level")') src = src.replace('fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Education Level",', 'fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Labor Force Percentage (%)",') with open('chart.py','w') as f: f.write(src) exec(compile(src,'chart.py','exec')) print(fig.data[0].type, list(fig.data[0].x), fig.layout.yaxis.title.text, fig.layout.xaxis.title.text) continue
